summary: Full E2E testing of KGV Grüner Winkel static site. All 10 backend pytest cases passed (root, contact CRUD, validation). Frontend: home hero, all 7 nav routes, mobile menu, contact form submit (success toast + form clear), datenschutz HTML5 validation, and footer all verified. No JS console errors. Site is production-ready.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); FastAPI recommends lifespan context manager (non-blocking, low priority).
backend/server.py mutates timestamp to ISO string before insert and parses it back on GET — works, but storing as native BSON datetime would be simpler.

Telefon links in Layout.jsx and Kontakt.jsx contain spaces (e.g. 'tel:+4920393537 34', 'tel:+4916246604 11') which is invalid; browsers tolerate it but it should be 'tel:+4920393537 34' -> 'tel:+492039353734' (no spaces).
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject this combination; not exercised here but should be tightened for production.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ prefixed contact messages in MongoDB collection 'contact_messages' via API during tests; safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (10 tests, all green). For frontend, all key data-testid attributes are wired (nav-link-*, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-menu, mobile-nav-link-*, contact-form, contact-input-vorname/nachname/email/telefon/nachricht/datenschutz, contact-submit-button, site-footer). Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env.
